zh: 这是我昨天说的那个文件。
en: This is the file I mentioned yesterday.
alt: Here's the document I was talking about yesterday.
point: “我昨天说的”要放在名词后面：the file I mentioned

zh: 坐我旁边的那个人是新来的。
en: The guy who sits next to me is new.
alt: The person sitting next to me is new.
point: 修饰人用 who，整个从句放在名词后面

zh: 你用的那个软件叫什么？
en: What's the software you're using called?
alt: What's that app you use called?
point: 从句夹在中间：the software you're using，called 放句末

zh: 我找不到你发的那个链接。
en: I can't find the link you sent.
alt: I can't find the link that you sent me.
point: “你发的链接”是 the link you sent，不说 you sent link

zh: 你点的那个汤怎么样？
en: How's the soup you ordered?
alt: How's that soup you got?
point: “你点的汤”是 the soup you ordered，修饰语放后面

zh: 我要跟她点的一样的。
en: I'll have what she's having.
alt: I'll have the same as her.
point: “她点的（东西）”可以直接用 what 代替 the thing that

zh: 赢的那队是惠灵顿来的。
en: The team that won is from Wellington.
alt: The winning team's from Wellington.
point: “赢的那队”是 the team that won，that 作主语不能省

zh: 他是我见过跑得最快的人。
en: He's the fastest runner I've ever seen.
alt: He's the fastest person I've ever seen run.
point: 最高级 + 从句：the fastest… I've ever seen

zh: 我想要橱窗里那件。
en: I'd like the one in the window.
alt: Can I have the one in the window?
point: “那件”用 the one 代替名词；in the window 直接放后面

zh: 你昨天买的鞋穿着舒服吗？
en: Are the shoes you bought yesterday comfy?
alt: Are the shoes you got yesterday comfortable?
point: 从句插在主语里：the shoes you bought…，are 提到最前

zh: 这是去机场的那趟车吗？
en: Is this the bus that goes to the airport?
alt: Is this the airport bus?
point: “去机场的车”是 the bus that goes to…，不是 go airport bus

zh: 我们住的酒店离海滩很近。
en: The hotel we're staying at is close to the beach.
alt: Our hotel's right near the beach.
point: stay at 的 at 要留在从句末尾

zh: 医生开的药我吃完了。
en: I've finished the pills the doctor gave me.
alt: I've run out of the medicine the doctor prescribed.
point: 把话题“医生开的药”放回宾语位置：the pills the doctor gave me

zh: 我需要一个周末也开门的诊所。
en: I need a clinic that's open at the weekend.
alt: I need a clinic that opens on weekends.
point: “周末开门的诊所”是 a clinic that's open…，形容词从句放后面

zh: 住楼上的邻居人很好。
en: The neighbours upstairs are really nice.
alt: The people who live upstairs are lovely.
point: 可简化成 the neighbours upstairs，不必写 who live；neighbour 英式拼写

zh: 我借你的那把伞你放哪儿了？
en: Where did you put the umbrella I lent you?
alt: What did you do with the umbrella I lent you?
point: “我借你的”是 I lent you，借出用 lend 不用 borrow

zh: 你认识跟Tom说话的那个女孩吗？
en: Do you know the girl talking to Tom?
alt: Do you know the girl who's talking to Tom?
point: 省略 who is：the girl talking to Tom

zh: 她就是我跟你说过的那个朋友。
en: She's the friend I told you about.
alt: That's the friend I was telling you about.
point: tell you about 的 about 不能丢在从句末尾

zh: 你上个月借的钱还了吗？
en: Have you paid back the money you borrowed last month?
alt: Did you pay back the money you borrowed last month?
point: “你借的钱”是 the money you borrowed；还钱是 pay back

zh: 我在找一张没有年费的信用卡。
en: I'm after a credit card with no annual fee.
alt: I'm looking for a credit card that doesn't have an annual fee.
point: “没有年费的”可用 with no…，比完整从句更顺口

zh: 负责这个项目的经理下个月就要退休了。
en: The manager who's in charge of this project is retiring next month.
alt: The manager running this project is retiring next month.
point: 主语带长从句，别漏掉后面的谓语 is retiring

zh: 我们上周面试的那个女生已经答应来上班了。
en: The woman we interviewed last week has accepted the job.
alt: The candidate we interviewed last week has said yes to the role.
point: 关系词作宾语可省：the woman (who) we interviewed

zh: 上周五出问题的那台服务器又宕机了。
en: The server that had problems last Friday has gone down again.
alt: The server that played up last Friday has crashed again.
point: that 作主语不能省；“宕机”是 go down

zh: 我需要一个能自动备份文件的工具。
en: I need a tool that can back up my files automatically.
alt: I need something that backs up my files automatically.
point: “能…的工具”是 a tool that can…，能力放从句里

zh: 坐在角落那桌的客人一晚上都在抱怨。
en: The people sitting at the corner table have been complaining all night.
alt: The people who are sitting in the corner have been moaning all evening.
point: 省略 who are：the people sitting at…

zh: 你上次推荐的那家越南粉店真的太好吃了。
en: That pho place you recommended last time was absolutely amazing.
alt: The pho place you told me about was really good.
point: “那家店”口语用 place；you recommended 紧跟在后面

zh: 我想找一个周末能一起打羽毛球的人。
en: I'm looking for someone I can play badminton with on weekends.
alt: I'm trying to find someone to play badminton with at the weekend.
point: 介词 with 放在从句末尾：someone I can play with

zh: 昨晚达阵制胜的那个球员才十九岁。
en: The player who scored the winning try last night is only nineteen.
alt: The guy who got the match-winning try last night is just nineteen.
point: who scored… 放 player 后面；橄榄球“达阵”是 score a try

zh: 我想退掉上周在Warehouse买的那个台灯。
en: I'd like to return the lamp I bought at the Warehouse last week.
alt: I want to take back the lamp I got from the Warehouse last week.
point: 从句 I bought… 紧跟 lamp，地点时间都放从句里

zh: 卖二手家具的那家店搬到Newmarket去了。
en: The shop that sells second-hand furniture has moved to Newmarket.
alt: That second-hand furniture shop has moved to Newmarket.
point: “卖…的那家店”是 the shop that sells…

zh: 我一直想去一个能看到冰川的地方。
en: I've always wanted to go somewhere you can see glaciers.
alt: I've always wanted to visit a place where you can see a glacier.
point: 地点从句用 where，或 somewhere 后直接接从句

zh: 开车带我们环岛的那个导游以前是个渔民。
en: The guide who drove us around the island used to be a fisherman.
alt: Our guide, who drove us round the island, used to be a fisherman.
point: who drove… 修饰 guide；“以前是”用 used to be

zh: 我在找一个会说中文的家庭医生。
en: I'm looking for a GP who speaks Chinese.
alt: I'm trying to find a family doctor who can speak Mandarin.
point: “会说中文的医生”是 a GP who speaks Chinese；家庭医生叫 GP

zh: 你上次说的那个理疗师在哪个诊所上班？
en: Which clinic does that physio you mentioned work at?
alt: Where does the physio you told me about work?
point: 从句插在疑问句中间：that physio you mentioned，at 放句末

zh: 我们刚搬进去的那套房子冬天特别冷。
en: The house we've just moved into is freezing in winter.
alt: The place we just moved into gets really cold in winter.
point: move into 的 into 留在从句末尾

zh: 你能把放在桌子上的那些信拿给我吗？
en: Can you pass me the letters that are on the table?
alt: Can you grab me the letters on the table?
point: “放在桌上的”可简化为 on the table，不必写 put on

zh: 我昨晚在派对上认识了一个在Xero上班的人。
en: I met someone at the party last night who works at Xero.
alt: Last night at the party I met a guy who works for Xero.
point: 从句可与先行词分开：someone… who works at Xero

zh: 她是那种不管什么事都愿意帮忙的人。
en: She's the kind of person who'll help anyone with anything.
alt: She's the type who'd do anything to help.
point: “那种…的人”是 the kind of person who…

zh: 我们每个月花在外卖上的钱太多了。
en: The money we spend on takeaways every month is way too much.
alt: We spend way too much on takeaways every month.
point: “花在…上的钱”是 the money we spend on…；外卖叫 takeaways

zh: 那个说能帮你避税的人肯定是骗子。
en: The guy who said he could help you avoid tax is definitely a scammer.
alt: Whoever told you they could get you out of paying tax is a scammer.
point: who said he could… 修饰 the guy；“骗子”说 scammer

zh: 你上周提的那几个建议我已经转给负责采购的同事了，她这几天应该会联系你。
en: I've passed the suggestions you made last week on to the colleague who handles purchasing, so she should be in touch in the next few days.
alt: I've forwarded your suggestions from last week to our procurement person, so she'll probably get in touch in the next couple of days.
point: 两个从句：the suggestions you made / the colleague who handles…

zh: 下周开会之前，请大家先看一下附件里那份列出了所有截止日期的文档。
en: Before next week's meeting, could everyone have a read of the attached document, which lists all the deadlines?
alt: Before the meeting next week, please read through the attached document that sets out all the deadlines.
point: “列出了…的文档”可用非限定从句 , which lists…

zh: 导致昨天服务中断的那个bug已经修好了，但我们还在查是哪次改动引入的。
en: The bug that caused yesterday's outage has been fixed, but we're still working out which change introduced it.
alt: We've fixed the bug behind yesterday's outage, but we're still trying to track down which change caused it.
point: “导致中断的bug”是 the bug that caused the outage

zh: 凡是还在用旧版VPN的同事，请在周五前升级，不然下周就连不上了。
en: Anyone who's still on the old version of the VPN needs to upgrade by Friday, or they won't be able to connect next week.
alt: If you're still using the old VPN, please upgrade before Friday, otherwise you won't be able to connect next week.
point: “凡是…的人”是 anyone who…，谓语用单数 needs

zh: 我们昨晚去的那家餐厅，就是主厨上过电视的那家，说实话有点名不副实。
en: The restaurant we went to last night, the one whose chef was on TV, was honestly a bit overrated.
alt: That place we went to last night, the one with the TV chef, honestly didn't live up to the hype.
point: whose 表示所属：the one whose chef…；“名不副实”说 overrated

zh: 如果你想找个能带孩子、又有户外座位的咖啡馆，我知道Ponsonby有一家很不错。
en: If you're after a café where you can take the kids and sit outside, I know a great one in Ponsonby.
alt: If you want a kid-friendly café with outdoor seating, there's a really good one in Ponsonby.
point: where 引导地点从句；“有一家”用 a great one 代替

zh: 那个从小就在我们俱乐部训练的女孩，刚刚入选了黑蕨队。
en: The girl who's been training at our club since she was little has just made the Black Ferns.
alt: The girl who's trained at our club since she was a kid has just been picked for the Black Ferns.
point: 长主语 who's been training… 之后别忘了谓语；入选说 make the team

zh: 教练跟我说过最有用的一句话是：比赛结果你控制不了，你能控制的只有自己的态度。
en: The best advice our coach ever gave me was that the result is out of your hands, and the only thing you can control is your attitude.
alt: The most useful thing my coach ever told me was that you can't control the result, only your attitude.
point: “你能控制的”是 the only thing you can control

zh: 我在网上买的那件外套跟照片完全不一样，我周一就给卖家发了邮件，到现在还没回。
en: The jacket I bought online looks nothing like the photos, and the seller, who I emailed on Monday, still hasn't got back to me.
alt: The jacket I ordered online is nothing like the pictures, and I emailed the seller on Monday but they still haven't replied.
point: 非限定从句 , who I emailed…, 插在主语和谓语之间

zh: 你还记得我们圣诞节前去的那个商场吗？就是停车场永远找不到位子的那个。
en: Do you remember the mall we went to before Christmas? The one where you could never find a park?
alt: Remember that shopping centre we went to before Christmas, where it was impossible to find a park?
point: the one where… 补充说明；新西兰“停车位”常说 a park

zh: 我们在皇后镇住的那个Airbnb，房东人特别好，还开车带我们去了一个只有当地人才知道的湖。
en: The host of the Airbnb we stayed at in Queenstown was lovely, and drove us out to a lake that only locals know about.
alt: Our Airbnb host in Queenstown was really nice and even took us to a lake only the locals know about.
point: 两个从句：the Airbnb we stayed at / a lake only locals know about

zh: 要是你有什么想带回国的东西，比如麦卢卡蜂蜜，最好到机场之前就买好，机场里卖的贵很多。
en: If there's anything you want to take home, like manuka honey, buy it before you get to the airport, because the stuff they sell there is way pricier.
alt: If you want to take anything home, like manuka honey, get it before the airport, since everything they sell there costs a lot more.
point: “想带回去的东西”是 anything you want to take home

zh: 公司给我们买的保险只报一部分专科费用，所以需要做手术的人还是得自己掏不少钱。
en: The insurance our company provides only covers part of the specialist fees, so people who need surgery still end up paying a fair bit themselves.
alt: Our work insurance only covers some of the specialist costs, so anyone who needs an operation still has to pay quite a lot out of pocket.
point: the insurance our company provides；泛指“…的人”用 people who…

zh: 给我做膝盖手术的医生说，我至少要等六周才能重新开始跑步。
en: The surgeon who operated on my knee said I'd have to wait at least six weeks before I could start running again.
alt: The surgeon who did my knee said I can't start running again for at least six weeks.
point: “给我做手术的医生”是 the surgeon who operated on my knee

zh: 这周末我们要把车库里那些好几年没碰过的东西清掉，有你想要的就拿走。
en: This weekend we're clearing out all the stuff in the garage that we haven't touched in years, so grab anything you want.
alt: We're sorting out the garage this weekend and getting rid of everything we haven't used in years, so help yourself to anything you like.
point: 从句可与先行词隔开：the stuff in the garage that…；anything you want

zh: 那个漏了好几个月的水龙头，房东终于要派人来修了。
en: The landlord's finally sending someone round to fix the tap that's been leaking for months.
alt: The landlord is finally getting someone in to fix that tap that's been dripping for months.
point: 话题前置要还原：fix the tap that's been leaking…；水龙头叫 tap

zh: 你还记得我们刚来新西兰时帮了我们很多的那个邻居吗？她下个月要搬去澳洲了。
en: Remember that neighbour who helped us out so much when we first came to New Zealand? She's moving to Australia next month.
alt: Do you remember the neighbour who was so good to us when we first arrived in New Zealand? She's moving to Australia next month.
point: who helped us out… 修饰 neighbour；口语可省 Do you

zh: Toastmasters里给我提意见最多的那位老会员，也是当初鼓励我去参加演讲比赛的人。
en: The long-time member at Toastmasters who's given me the most feedback is also the one who talked me into entering the speech contest.
alt: The longtime Toastmasters member who gives me the most feedback is the same person who encouraged me to enter the speech contest.
point: 两层从句：the member who… / the one who talked me into…

zh: 我们之前看的那套带大后院的房子，听说已经以高于标价的价格卖出去了。
en: That house we looked at, the one with the big backyard, apparently went for more than the asking price.
alt: Apparently the house we saw with the big backyard sold for over the asking price.
point: the one with… 代替从句；“高于标价”说 over the asking price

zh: 我想找个能帮我理清KiwiSaver和投资的理财顾问，最好是收费透明、不靠卖产品拿佣金的那种。
en: I'm looking for a financial adviser who can help me sort out my KiwiSaver and investments, ideally someone whose fees are clear and who doesn't work on commission.
alt: I want a financial adviser who can help me get my KiwiSaver and investments sorted, preferably one with transparent fees who isn't paid on commission.
point: who can help…；whose fees are clear；“理清”说 sort out

zh: 今天上午打电话来的那个客户又打来了。
en: The client who rang this morning is calling again.
alt: That client who called this morning is on the phone again.
point: “上午打电话来的”放在 client 后面：the client who rang…

zh: 这是我唯一记得住的密码。
en: This is the only password I can remember.
alt: It's the only password I remember.
point: the only + 名词后接从句，关系词可省：the only password I…

zh: 我们上次坐的那张桌子现在空着吗？
en: Is the table we sat at last time free?
alt: Is the table we had last time available?
point: sit at 的 at 留在从句末尾：the table we sat at

zh: 我去的那家健身房早上五点就开门。
en: The gym I go to opens at five.
alt: My gym opens at five in the morning.
point: “我去的健身房”是 the gym I go to，to 不能丢

zh: 这不是我订的那个颜色。
en: This isn't the colour I ordered.
alt: That's not the colour I asked for.
point: “我订的颜色”是 the colour I ordered；英式拼写 colour

zh: 我们要坐的那班飞机晚点了。
en: The flight we're catching is delayed.
alt: Our flight's been delayed.
point: “要坐的飞机”是 the flight we're catching，用 catch 不用 sit

zh: 疼的那颗牙在左边。
en: The tooth that hurts is on the left.
alt: It's the one on the left that hurts.
point: “疼的那颗牙”是 the tooth that hurts，that 作主语不能省

zh: 你包的饺子真好吃。
en: The dumplings you made are delicious.
alt: Your dumplings are so good.
point: “你包的饺子”是 the dumplings you made，从句跟在名词后

zh: 你昨天带来的那个朋友叫什么名字？
en: What's the name of the friend you brought yesterday?
alt: What's your friend from yesterday called?
point: the friend you brought yesterday，不说 you brought friend

zh: 这个月我们能花的就这么多了。
en: That's all we can spend this month.
alt: That's all we've got to spend this month.
point: “能花的就这么多”用 all we can spend，all 后省略 that

zh: 我申请的那份工作已经招到人了。
en: The job I applied for has been filled.
alt: They've already found someone for the job I applied for.
point: apply for 的 for 留在从句末尾：the job I applied for

zh: 面试我的那个人特别友好。
en: The person who interviewed me was really friendly.
alt: The guy who interviewed me was super friendly.
point: “面试我的人”：who 作主语，后面直接接动词 interviewed

zh: 我想找一份能在家上班的工作。
en: I want a job where I can work from home.
alt: I'm looking for a job I can do from home.
point: “能在家上班的工作”可用 a job where…，where 指情况

zh: 教写作课的那个老师是苏格兰人。
en: The teacher who runs our writing class is Scottish.
alt: The woman who teaches the writing class is Scottish.
point: “教写作课的老师”：who runs/teaches… 整体放在 teacher 后

zh: 你有我们上课用的那本书吗？
en: Have you got the book we use in class?
alt: Do you have the textbook we use in class?
point: “上课用的书”是 the book we use in class，不说 class use book

zh: 考试里我觉得最难的是听力。
en: The part I found hardest was the listening.
alt: The hardest part for me was the listening.
point: “我觉得最难的”是 the part I found hardest，find + 形容词

zh: 我们看的那套房子太小了。
en: The flat we looked at was too small.
alt: The place we viewed was too small.
point: look at 的 at 别丢：the flat we looked at；公寓说 flat

zh: 房东发来的合同我还没签。
en: I haven't signed the tenancy agreement the landlord sent yet.
alt: I still haven't signed the lease the landlord sent me.
point: 话题“房东发来的合同”要放回 signed 后面当宾语

zh: 我想租一个带车库的房子。
en: I want to rent a place with a garage.
alt: I'm looking for a place that has a garage.
point: “带车库的”用 with a garage 比 that has 更简洁

zh: 养大狗的那家人搬走了。
en: The people with the big dog have moved out.
alt: The family who had the big dog have moved away.
point: “养大狗的那家人”可用 with：the people with the big dog

zh: 停在我家车道上的那辆车是谁的？
en: Whose car is that parked in my driveway?
alt: Who owns the car that's parked in my driveway?
point: 省略 that is：the car parked in my driveway

zh: 刚搬到隔壁的那对夫妻人挺好的。
en: The couple who just moved in next door seem nice.
alt: The new couple next door seem lovely.
point: move in 后面再接 next door；主语是 couple，谓语在从句之后

zh: 我们上个月收到的电费单特别高。
en: The power bill we got last month was huge.
alt: Last month's power bill was really high.
point: “收到的电费单”是 the power bill we got；电费单说 power bill

zh: 我想要一个不用签合约的手机套餐。
en: I want a mobile plan that doesn't need a contract.
alt: I'd like a phone plan with no contract.
point: “不用签合约的”：that doesn't need…，否定放在从句里

zh: 我们家是停电的那几户之一。
en: We're one of the houses that lost power.
alt: Our house is one of the ones without power.
point: one of the houses that lost…：从句修饰复数 houses

zh: 修水管的师傅明天来。
en: The plumber who's fixing our pipes is coming tomorrow.
alt: The guy fixing our pipes comes tomorrow.
point: “修水管的师傅”：plumber 后接 who's fixing…，不说 fix pipe plumber

zh: 你推荐的那个电工靠谱吗？
en: Is the electrician you recommended any good?
alt: Is that electrician you suggested reliable?
point: 从句插进疑问句：Is the electrician you recommended…

zh: 我需要一个会修旧冰箱的人。
en: I need someone who can fix an old fridge.
alt: I need somebody who knows how to repair old fridges.
point: “会修…的人”是 someone who can fix…

zh: 我要填的那张表在哪儿下载？
en: Where can I download the form I need to fill in?
alt: Where do I get the form I have to fill out?
point: “要填的表”是 the form I need to fill in，in 留在句末

zh: 接电话的那个人让我明天再打。
en: The person who answered told me to call back tomorrow.
alt: The woman who picked up said to ring back tomorrow.
point: “接电话的人”是 the person who answered，主语别漏谓语 told

zh: 这是你要的所有材料。
en: Here are all the documents you asked for.
alt: These are all the papers you wanted.
point: ask for 的 for 放句末：the documents you asked for

zh: 抢我包的那个人跑了。
en: The man who grabbed my bag ran off.
alt: The guy who snatched my bag got away.
point: “抢我包的人”：the man who grabbed my bag，从句后才是谓语

zh: 我丢的那个钱包是黑色的。

alt: It's a black wallet I lost.
point: “我丢的钱包”是 the wallet I lost，不说 my lost wallet is

zh: 受伤的那个人还清醒。
en: The person who's hurt is still conscious.
alt: The injured man is still conscious.
point: “受伤的人”：the person who's hurt 或 the injured person

zh: 我平时坐的那班公交今天没来。
en: The bus I normally catch didn't come today.
alt: My usual bus didn't turn up today.
point: “我坐的那班车”：the bus I catch，坐公交用 catch

zh: 撞了我车的那个司机没停车。
en: The driver who hit my car didn't stop.
alt: The guy who crashed into me drove off.
point: “撞我车的司机”：the driver who hit my car

zh: 这附近有能免费停车的地方吗？
en: Is there anywhere round here I can park for free?
alt: Is there somewhere nearby where I can park for free?
point: anywhere 后直接接从句：anywhere I can park

zh: 你带的防晒霜能借我用一下吗？
en: Can I borrow the sunscreen you brought?
alt: Could I use some of the sunblock you brought?
point: “你带的防晒霜”是 the sunscreen you brought

zh: 我们露营的那个地方晚上特别冷。
en: The place where we camped was freezing at night.
alt: Where we camped was freezing at night.
point: 地点从句用 where：the place where we camped

zh: 我想找一个人不多的海滩。
en: I'd like to find a beach that isn't too crowded.
alt: I want a beach that's not too busy.
point: “人不多的海滩”：a beach that isn't crowded，不说 people not many beach

zh: 我昨晚看的那部电影太无聊了。
en: The movie I watched last night was so boring.
alt: That film I saw last night was really boring.
point: “我昨晚看的电影”：the movie I watched last night

zh: 平时给我剪头发的那个人今天休息。
en: The guy who usually cuts my hair is off today.
alt: My usual barber isn't working today.
point: “给我剪头发的人”：the guy who cuts my hair；休息说 is off

zh: 你在看的那本书好看吗？
en: Is the book you're reading any good?
alt: Is that book you're reading good?
point: “在看的书”用 reading，从句插在 Is 和 any good 之间

zh: 你送我的礼物我特别喜欢。
en: I love the present you gave me.
alt: I really like the gift you got me.
point: 话题“你送我的礼物”放回宾语：love the present you gave me

zh: 要结婚的是我表姐。
en: It's my cousin who's getting married.
alt: My cousin's the one getting married.
point: “要…的是X”用强调句 It's X who…

zh: 我们要去的那个婚礼在海边办。
en: The wedding we're going to is on the beach.
alt: The wedding we're going to is being held on the beach.
point: go to 的 to 留在从句：the wedding we're going to

zh: 接我女儿放学的是我妈。
en: The woman who picks up my daughter is my mum.
alt: It's my mum who picks my daughter up from school.
point: “接…的（人）”要补出 the woman who…，不能直接用动词开头

zh: 我儿子想要的就是一只小狗。
en: All my son wants is a puppy.
alt: The only thing my son wants is a puppy.
point: “想要的就是…”：All he wants is…，all = 唯一的东西

zh: 这就是我小时候住的房子。
en: This is the house I grew up in.
alt: This is the house I lived in as a kid.
point: grow up in 的 in 放句末：the house I grew up in

zh: 一直叫个不停的那只狗是谁家的？
en: Who owns the dog that keeps barking?
alt: Whose is that dog that won't stop barking?
point: “叫个不停的狗”：the dog that keeps barking

zh: 我们上次去的那个兽医很贵。
en: The vet we went to last time was really expensive.
alt: The vet we saw last time was really pricey.
point: the vet we went to，to 不能省

zh: 我家狗把我刚买的鞋咬坏了。
en: My dog chewed up the shoes I just bought.
alt: The dog's wrecked the new shoes I just got.
point: “刚买的鞋”：the shoes I just bought，不说 just bought shoes

zh: 我现在最需要的就是好好睡一觉。
en: What I need most right now is a good sleep.
alt: The thing I need most right now is a decent sleep.
point: “最需要的”用 what 开头：What I need most is…

zh: 她是唯一一个懂我的人。
en: She's the only one who gets me.
alt: She's the only person who understands me.
point: “唯一懂我的人”：the only one who…；口语 get = 理解

zh: 这是我今年听到的最好的消息。
en: That's the best news I've had all year.
alt: That's the best thing I've heard all year.
point: 最高级后接从句：the best news I've had，用现在完成时

zh: 我们下周要见的那个客户是从悉尼飞过来的。
en: The client we're meeting next week is flying in from Sydney.
alt: The client we're seeing next week is coming over from Sydney.
point: “要见的客户”：the client we're meeting，从句后才是谓语 is flying

zh: 我们公司用的那个工时系统老是出毛病。
en: The timesheet system we use at work keeps playing up.
alt: The timesheet software we use at work is always crashing.
point: the system we use at work；“出毛病”口语 play up

zh: 你们菜单上有不含麸质的菜吗？
en: Have you got anything on the menu that's gluten-free?
alt: Do you have any gluten-free dishes?
point: 从句可与先行词隔开：anything on the menu that's…

zh: 我昨天在健身房认识了一个练了二十年举重的人。
en: At the gym yesterday I met a guy who's been lifting weights for twenty years.
alt: Yesterday at the gym I met someone who's done weightlifting for twenty years.
point: 从句里用现在完成进行时：who's been lifting… for twenty years

zh: 我想买一件下雨天也能穿的外套。
en: I'm looking for a jacket I can wear when it rains.
alt: I want a coat that I can wear in the rain.
point: “能穿的外套”：a jacket I can wear，can 放在从句里

zh: 你上次说的那个能看萤火虫的洞叫什么名字？
en: What's the name of that cave you mentioned where you can see glow-worms?
alt: What was that glow-worm cave you told me about called?
point: 一个名词带两个从句：the cave you mentioned + where you can see…

zh: 我在等的那个专科预约还要三个月。
en: The specialist appointment I'm waiting for is still three months away.
alt: I've still got three months to wait for my specialist appointment.
point: wait for 的 for 留在从句末：the appointment I'm waiting for

zh: 我们去年种的那棵柠檬树今年终于结果了。
en: The lemon tree we planted last year has finally got fruit on it.
alt: The lemon tree we put in last year is finally fruiting.
point: 时间状语放在从句里：the tree we planted last year

zh: 你上周烧烤带来的那个沙拉是怎么做的？
en: How did you make that salad you brought to the barbecue last week?
alt: What's in that salad you brought to the barbie last week?
point: 疑问句的宾语带从句：make that salad you brought…

zh: 我用来存钱的那个账户几乎没什么利息。
en: The account I use for savings pays hardly any interest.
alt: My savings account barely earns any interest.
point: “用来存钱的账户”：the account I use for savings

zh: 给我写推荐信的那位老板已经退休了。
en: The boss who wrote my reference has already retired.
alt: My old boss who gave me a reference has retired now.
point: who wrote my reference 修饰 boss；推荐信说 reference

zh: 我想去一家愿意花钱培训员工的公司。
en: I'd like to work for a company that invests in training its staff.
alt: I want to join a company that's willing to pay for staff training.
point: “愿意…的公司”：a company that invests in…

zh: 他们发给我的合同里有一条我看不懂。
en: There's a clause in the contract they sent me that I don't understand.
alt: There's one part of the contract they sent that I can't make sense of.
point: 一句里两个从句：the contract they sent me 和 that I don't understand

zh: 我上学期选的那门课比我想的难多了。
en: The course I took last semester was way harder than I expected.
alt: The paper I did last semester was much harder than I thought it would be.
point: “选的课”：the course I took，选课用 take

zh: 图书馆里有个可以借笔记本电脑的地方。
en: There's a desk in the library where you can borrow laptops.
alt: There's a spot in the library where they lend out laptops.
point: 地点从句：a desk where you can borrow…

zh: 还没交作业的同学这周五之前要补交。
en: Students who haven't handed in the assignment need to do it by Friday.
alt: Anyone who hasn't submitted the assignment has to get it in by Friday.
point: “没交作业的同学”：students who haven't handed in…，交作业 hand in

zh: 我们看房时碰到的那个中介说房子已经租出去了。
en: The agent we met at the viewing said the place has already been let.
alt: The property manager we met at the viewing said it's already been rented.
point: the agent we met at the viewing，后面才接谓语 said

zh: 我在找一个房租包电费的地方。
en: I'm looking for a flat where the power's included in the rent.
alt: I want a place where the rent covers power.
point: “房租包电费的地方”用 where 引出一个完整句子

zh: 刚搬走的那个室友还欠我们两百块电费。
en: The flatmate who just moved out still owes us two hundred for power.
alt: Our old flatmate who's just left still owes us two hundred bucks for the power.
point: “刚搬走的室友”：the flatmate who just moved out

zh: 每天早上六点就割草的那个邻居快把我逼疯了。
en: The neighbour who mows his lawn at six every morning is driving me mad.
alt: The guy next door who mows at six every morning is driving me nuts.
point: 长主语 the neighbour who mows… 后面接谓语 is driving

zh: 我们这条街有个每个月组织一次清洁活动的小组。
en: There's a group on our street that organises a clean-up every month.
alt: There's a group on our street that runs a monthly clean-up.
point: there's + 名词 + that…；英式拼写 organises

zh: 昨天走丢的那只猫是拐角那户人家的。
en: The cat that went missing yesterday belongs to the family on the corner.
alt: The cat that got lost yesterday is the one from the house on the corner.
point: “走丢的猫”：the cat that went missing；“是…的”用 belongs to

zh: 上门装光纤的那个师傅说下午才能到。
en: The guy who's installing our fibre says he can't get here till the afternoon.
alt: The fibre installer says he won't make it until the afternoon.
point: “装光纤的师傅”：the guy who's installing our fibre

zh: 我打过去的那个客服让我等了四十分钟。
en: The call centre I rang kept me on hold for forty minutes.
alt: When I called the helpline they left me on hold for forty minutes.
point: “打过去的客服”：the call centre I rang；“让我等”是 kept me on hold

zh: 我们现在用的套餐每个月流量都不够。
en: The plan we're on doesn't give us enough data each month.
alt: We keep running out of data on the plan we've got.
point: “用的套餐”说 the plan we're on，介词 on 放句中

zh: 上周换的那个热水器又不热了。
en: The hot water cylinder they replaced last week has stopped working again.
alt: The new hot water cylinder they put in last week isn't heating again.
point: 中文省略“他们”，从句要补主语：the cylinder they replaced

zh: 我在网上找了一个周末也能上门的水管工。
en: I found a plumber online who can come out at the weekend.
alt: I've found a plumber online who does weekend call-outs.
point: 从句与先行词隔开：a plumber online who can…

zh: 他报的价是另外两家的两倍。
en: The quote he gave us was double what the other two charged.
alt: His quote was twice as much as the other two.
point: “另外两家（收的）”用 what：double what the others charged

zh: 我上个月寄出去的护照申请到现在还没消息。
en: I still haven't heard anything about the passport application I sent off last month.
alt: There's still no news on the passport application I posted last month.
point: the application I sent off last month，寄出用 send off

zh: 市政府负责建筑许可的那个部门在三楼。
en: The team that handles building consents at the council is on the third floor.
alt: The council's building consents team is on the third floor.
point: “负责…的部门”：the team that handles…；许可说 consent

zh: 你得带一个能证明你住址的东西。
en: You'll need to bring something that shows your address.
alt: You need to bring proof of address.
point: “能证明…的东西”：something that shows…

zh: 我们打111时接电话的那个人特别冷静。
en: The person who answered when we rang 111 was really calm.
alt: The 111 operator who took our call was really calm.
point: 从句里还套时间从句：who answered when we rang…

zh: 地震时我们躲的那张桌子特别结实。
en: The table we hid under during the earthquake was really solid.
alt: The table we sheltered under in the quake was really sturdy.
point: hide under 的 under 留在从句：the table we hid under

zh: 昨晚撬我们车的人把我的笔记本电脑拿走了。
en: Whoever broke into our car last night took my laptop.
alt: The person who broke into our car last night stole my laptop.
point: 不知道是谁时用 whoever = the person who

zh: 我买的那辆二手车下个月要做WOF了。
en: The second-hand car I bought is due for its WOF next month.
alt: The used car I got needs a WOF next month.
point: the car I bought 后接谓语 is due for

zh: 我公司附近有个早上八点前免费停车的停车场。
en: There's a car park near my work that's free before eight.
alt: There's a car park by my office where it's free to park before eight.
point: 从句修饰 car park，中间隔着 near my work

zh: 我前面那辆卡车一路都在掉石子。
en: The truck in front of me kept dropping stones on the road.
alt: The truck that was in front of me kept spilling gravel.
point: “我前面的卡车”简化为 the truck in front of me

zh: 我们去年夏天去的那个营地今年关了。
en: The campsite we went to last summer is closed this year.
alt: The camping ground we stayed at last summer has shut this year.
point: the campsite we went to last summer，to 不能省

zh: 去爬山的人一定要带够水。
en: Anyone who goes tramping should take plenty of water.
alt: If you go tramping, make sure you take enough water.
point: 泛指“…的人”用 anyone who…，谓语用单数

zh: 我想找一条小孩也能走的短步道。
en: I'm looking for a short walk that's easy enough for the kids.
alt: I want a short track the kids can manage.
point: “小孩也能走的”：that's easy enough for the kids

zh: 我上周去的那场演唱会是我看过最好的。
en: The concert I went to last week was the best I've ever been to.
alt: Last week's concert was the best one I've ever seen.
point: 两个从句：the concert I went to / the best I've ever been to

zh: 我加入了一个每周四晚上玩桌游的俱乐部。
en: I've joined a club that plays board games every Thursday night.
alt: I've joined a board game club that meets on Thursday nights.
point: “每周四玩桌游的俱乐部”：a club that plays…

zh: 你一直推荐的那部剧我终于开始看了。
en: I've finally started watching that show you keep recommending.
alt: I've finally started that series you've been telling me about.
point: 话题前置要还原：started watching that show you…

zh: 我们送她的那条项链她好像不太喜欢。
en: I don't think she liked the necklace we got her.
alt: She didn't seem very keen on the necklace we gave her.
point: “我们送她的项链”：the necklace we got her；“好像不”用 I don't think

zh: 能来参加婚礼的人请在周五前回复。
en: Could everyone who's coming to the wedding RSVP by Friday?
alt: If you're coming to the wedding, please RSVP by Friday.
point: “能来的人”：everyone who's coming，everyone 后用单数

zh: 过年时我最想念的是我妈包的饺子。
en: What I miss most at Chinese New Year is the dumplings my mum makes.
alt: The thing I miss most at Chinese New Year is my mum's dumplings.
point: what 从句作主语 + the dumplings my mum makes

zh: 教我女儿游泳的那个教练说她进步很快。
en: The coach who teaches my daughter to swim says she's improving fast.
alt: My daughter's swimming coach says she's coming along really well.
point: teach sb to swim 整个放进从句，修饰 coach

zh: 我儿子班上有个特别爱咬人的小孩。
en: There's a kid in my son's class who keeps biting people.
alt: There's a boy in my son's class who bites other kids.
point: 从句可隔开：a kid in my son's class who…

zh: 我婆婆送的那些衣服孩子都穿不下了。
en: The kids have grown out of the clothes my mother-in-law gave them.
alt: The clothes my mother-in-law gave the kids don't fit them anymore.
point: “穿不下”是 grow out of，宾语 the clothes my mother-in-law gave them

zh: 我们从SPCA领养的那只猫特别黏人。
en: The cat we adopted from the SPCA is really clingy.
alt: The cat we got from the SPCA is super affectionate.
point: the cat we adopted from…，从句后才到 is

zh: 这周末我们需要一个能帮忙照顾狗的人。
en: We need someone who can look after our dog this weekend.
alt: We need someone to look after the dog this weekend.
point: “能照顾…的人”：someone who can look after…，或 someone to…

zh: 这附近有没有狗可以不拴绳的公园？
en: Is there a park around here where dogs can go off the lead?
alt: Is there an off-lead dog park near here?
point: where 引出完整句子；“不拴绳”说 off the lead

zh: 那个一直挺我的朋友下个月要回国了。
en: The friend who's always had my back is going home next month.
alt: My friend who's always supported me is moving back home next month.
point: “一直挺我的朋友”：who's always had my back

zh: 我很难再相信一个骗过我的人。
en: It's hard to trust someone who's lied to me before.
alt: I find it hard to trust anyone who's lied to me.
point: “骗过我的人”：someone who's lied to me，用现在完成时

zh: 我们之间那件不愉快的事我已经不在意了。
en: I've let go of what happened between us.
alt: I'm over the thing that happened between us.
point: “那件事”不必说 the thing，用 what happened 更自然

zh: 我们组那个刚生孩子的同事这个月都在家办公。
en: The guy on our team whose baby was just born is working from home this month.
alt: The colleague on our team who's just had a baby is working from home this month.
point: “他的孩子刚出生”用 whose baby…，不说 who his baby

zh: 我不太喜欢我们经理开会的方式，每次都拖很久。
en: I'm not a fan of the way our manager runs meetings, because they always drag on.
alt: I don't love how our manager runs meetings, since they always go on forever.
point: “…的方式”是 the way + 从句，不加 how

zh: 上周开会讨论的那些问题，到现在一个都没解决。
en: None of the issues we discussed at last week's meeting have been sorted out yet.
alt: We still haven't resolved any of the problems we talked about at last week's meeting.
point: none of + 带从句的名词作主语：None of the issues we discussed…

zh: 我在找一个手机和电脑都能用的密码管理器。
en: I'm looking for a password manager that works on both my phone and my laptop.
alt: I need a password manager I can use on my phone and my computer.
point: “都能用的”：that works on both…，主语是工具本身

zh: 你还记得我们当初为什么把旧系统换掉吗？
en: Do you remember the reason we got rid of the old system?
alt: Can you remember why we ditched the old system?
point: “为什么…”可说 the reason (why) we…，名词后接从句

zh: 我把文件存到了一个只有管理员能打开的文件夹里。
en: I've saved the files in a folder that only admins can access.
alt: I've put the files in a folder only the admins have access to.
point: “只有…能打开的”：that only admins can access，only 在从句里

zh: 我投了一家总部在惠灵顿、但允许远程办公的公司。
en: I've applied to a company that's based in Wellington but lets people work remotely.
alt: I've applied for a job at a Wellington company that allows remote work.
point: 一个 that 带两个谓语：that's based in… but lets…

zh: 面试官让我举一个我解决过难题的例子。
en: The interviewer asked me for an example of a time when I'd solved a tricky problem.
alt: The interviewer asked me to describe a time I'd solved a difficult problem.
point: “…的时候/经历”用 a time when…，面试常用

zh: 我的推荐人之一是我以前的经理，她现在住在澳洲。
en: One of my referees is my old manager, who's now living in Australia.
alt: One of my referees is a former manager of mine who lives in Australia now.
point: 补充说明用逗号 + who（非限定从句），不能用 that

zh: 我报的那个夜校英语班，老师是一个在中国教过书的新西兰人。
en: The night class I've signed up for is taught by a Kiwi who used to teach in China.
alt: The evening class I've enrolled in is run by a New Zealander who once taught in China.
point: 两个从句：the class I've signed up for / a Kiwi who used to…

zh: 考试没及格的学生可以申请补考。
en: Students who fail the exam can apply to resit it.
alt: Anyone who fails the exam is allowed to apply for a resit.
point: “没及格的学生”：students who fail…；补考说 resit

zh: 我需要一个安静、能待一整天不被打扰的学习地方。
en: I need somewhere quiet where I can study all day without being interrupted.
alt: I need a quiet place to study where nobody will bother me all day.
point: somewhere + 形容词 + where 从句，形容词放 somewhere 后面

zh: 后院那棵树掉下来的叶子把排水沟堵了。
en: The leaves falling off the tree in our backyard have blocked the gutters.
alt: The leaves that come off the tree out the back have clogged the gutters.
point: 用 -ing 简化从句：the leaves falling off the tree

zh: 我把不要的衣服捐给了一家帮助难民的二手慈善店。
en: I gave the clothes I didn't want to an op shop that helps refugees.
alt: I donated my old clothes to an op shop that supports refugees.
point: 两个从句：the clothes I didn't want / an op shop that helps…

zh: 哪些东西能放进回收桶，盖子上都写着。
en: Everything that can go in the recycling bin is listed on the lid.
alt: It says on the lid what can go in the recycling bin.
point: “哪些东西能…”改成 everything that can…作主语

zh: 我们签的租约里有一条说不能在墙上挂东西。
en: The lease we signed has a clause saying we can't put anything up on the walls.
alt: There's a clause in our tenancy agreement that says we can't hang anything on the walls.
point: the lease we signed；“说…的条款”可简化为 a clause saying…

zh: 房东要每个租客都提供一封以前房东的推荐信。
en: The landlord wants every tenant to provide a reference from someone they've rented from before.
alt: The landlord wants a reference from each tenant's previous landlord.
point: rent from 的 from 留在句末：someone they've rented from

zh: 他们扣了我们一部分押金，给的理由是地毯上有污渍。
en: The reason they gave for keeping part of our bond was a stain on the carpet.
alt: They held back some of our bond, and the reason they gave was a carpet stain.
point: “给的理由”：the reason they gave，押金说 bond

zh: 隔壁那家，就是车老停在人行道上的那家，又在开派对了。
en: The people next door, the ones whose car is always on the footpath, are having another party.
alt: The neighbours who always park on the footpath are having another party.
point: the ones whose car…：whose 表示“他们的”；人行道说 footpath

zh: 我们这片有个专门帮老人做家务的志愿者小组。
en: There's a volunteer group in our area that helps older people with their housework.
alt: There's a group of volunteers round here who help elderly people with housework.
point: help sb with sth 整个放进从句：that helps older people with…

zh: 我们跟隔壁共用的那道篱笆被昨晚的大风吹倒了。
en: The fence we share with next door was blown down in last night's wind.
alt: Last night's wind knocked over the fence between us and next door.
point: “共用的篱笆”：the fence we share with next door

zh: 我们收到一张燃气账单，金额是平时的两倍。
en: We got a gas bill that was twice what we normally pay.
alt: Our gas bill came in at double what we usually pay.
point: “平时（付）的”用 what：twice what we normally pay

zh: 我给电力公司打电话，接电话的人说是电表读错了。
en: I rang the power company, and the person I spoke to said the meter had been misread.
alt: When I called the power company, the guy I talked to said they'd read the meter wrong.
point: “接电话的人”可说 the person I spoke to，to 放末尾

zh: 我们换成了一个晚上电费更便宜的套餐。
en: We've switched to a plan where power's cheaper at night.
alt: We've moved to a plan that gives us cheaper power at night.
point: where 也可指“情况/方案”：a plan where…

zh: 来报价的三个建筑商里，只有一个是准时到的。
en: Of the three builders who came to quote, only one turned up on time.
alt: Only one of the three builders who came round to quote was on time.
point: of + 带从句的名词 开头：Of the three builders who came…

zh: 我们请来修屋顶的那个人活儿干得特别好。
en: The guy we got in to fix the roof did a brilliant job.
alt: The roofer we hired did a fantastic job.
point: “请来修…的人”：the guy we got in to fix…

zh: 我买的那台洗碗机保修期刚过就坏了。
en: The dishwasher I bought broke down just after the warranty ran out.
alt: The dishwasher I got died right after the warranty expired.
point: the dishwasher I bought 作主语，后接 broke down

zh: 刚才帮我拿尺码的那个店员我找不到了。
en: I can't find the shop assistant who was helping me with sizes.
alt: I've lost track of the staff member who was getting me different sizes.
point: 话题“帮我…的店员”放回宾语位置

zh: 网上订的东西都可以去离你最近的门店取。
en: Anything you order online can be picked up from the store that's closest to you.
alt: You can collect anything you buy online from your nearest store.
point: anything you order online 作主语；the store that's closest…

zh: 我等了两个星期的那个包裹送错地址了。
en: The parcel I'd been waiting two weeks for was delivered to the wrong address.
alt: The package I'd waited a fortnight for went to the wrong address.
point: wait for 的 for 跑到从句最后：the parcel I'd been waiting for

zh: 那个对坚果过敏的客人上错了菜。
en: The customer who's allergic to nuts was given the wrong dish.
alt: They brought the wrong dish to the guest with the nut allergy.
point: “对…过敏的客人”：who's allergic to…，be 动词别漏

zh: 我们常去的那家早午餐店换了老板以后就不一样了。
en: The brunch place we always go to hasn't been the same since it changed owners.
alt: Our usual brunch spot hasn't been the same since the new owners took over.
point: the place we always go to，从句之后才是 hasn't been

zh: 服务员推荐了一款跟羊肉很配的红酒。
en: The waiter recommended a red that goes really well with lamb.
alt: The waiter suggested a red wine that would go nicely with the lamb.
point: “跟…很配的”：that goes well with…

zh: 我收到一条自称是银行的短信，让我点一个链接。
en: I got a text from someone claiming to be my bank, asking me to click a link.
alt: I received a message that said it was from my bank and asked me to click a link.
point: 用 -ing 代替 who claimed：someone claiming to be…

zh: 我宁可把钱存在一个随时能取的账户里。
en: I'd rather put my savings in an account I can get at any time.
alt: I'd prefer to keep my money in an account I can access whenever I want.
point: “随时能取的账户”：an account I can get at，at 留在后面

zh: 帮我们办房贷的那个经纪人帮我们省了不少钱。
en: The mortgage broker who sorted out our home loan saved us a lot of money.
alt: Our mortgage broker, who arranged our loan, saved us heaps.
point: “办房贷的经纪人”：the broker who sorted out our home loan

zh: 我需要一份能证明我在新西兰住满五年的文件。
en: I need a document that proves I've lived in New Zealand for five years.
alt: I need something that shows I've been living in New Zealand for five years.
point: that proves + 宾语从句，两层从句嵌套

zh: 我去的那个办事处，排队都排到门外去了。
en: The office I went to had a queue that stretched out the door.
alt: At the office I went to, the queue went right out the door.
point: 两个从句：the office I went to / a queue that stretched…

zh: 签证官又让我交一份我已经交过的材料。
en: The visa officer asked me for a document I'd already sent them.
alt: The immigration officer wanted a document I'd already given them.
point: “已经交过的材料”：a document I'd already sent，用过去完成时

zh: 医生把我转给了一个专看皮肤病的专科医生。
en: My GP referred me to a specialist who deals with skin conditions.
alt: My doctor sent me to a skin specialist.
point: “专看…的医生”：a specialist who deals with…

zh: 药剂师给了我一种不用处方就能买的止痛药。
en: The pharmacist gave me some painkillers you can get without a prescription.
alt: The pharmacist gave me an over-the-counter painkiller.
point: 泛指“能买到的”从句主语用 you：painkillers you can get…

zh: 牙医诊所那个总记不住我名字的前台，今天居然叫对了。
en: The receptionist at my dentist's, the one who can never remember my name, actually got it right today.
alt: The receptionist at the dentist who always forgets my name finally got it right today.
point: 插入 the one who… 补充说明前面的人

zh: 暴风雨那晚帮我们把倒下的树挪开的那几个邻居太好了。
en: The neighbours who helped us move the fallen tree during the storm were amazing.
alt: The neighbours who helped shift the tree that came down in the storm were fantastic.
point: 长主语 the neighbours who helped us… 后再接 were

zh: 我把被偷的东西都报了警，警察给了我一个案件编号。
en: I reported the things that were stolen, and the police gave me a reference number.
alt: I told the police everything that was taken, and they gave me a reference number.
point: “被偷的东西”：the things that were stolen，从句用被动

zh: 我们在楼梯下放了一个包，里面是地震时需要的所有东西。
en: We keep a kit under the stairs with everything we'd need in an earthquake.
alt: We've got an emergency bag under the stairs with all the stuff we'd need in a quake.
point: “需要的所有东西”：everything we'd need，用 would 表假设

zh: 我在找一个能做WOF、周六也开门的修车厂。
en: I'm looking for a garage that does WOFs and is open on Saturdays.
alt: I need a mechanic that does WOFs on Saturdays.
point: 一个 that 接两个谓语：that does WOFs and is open…

zh: 我被罚款那天停车的位置其实是个装卸区。
en: The spot where I parked the day I got the ticket was actually a loading zone.
alt: Where I parked on the day I got fined was actually a loading zone.
point: 两个从句：the spot where I parked / the day I got the ticket

zh: 我借给朋友的那辆车还回来的时候油箱是空的。
en: The car I lent my mate came back with an empty tank.
alt: When my friend returned the car I'd lent him, the tank was empty.
point: “借给朋友的车”：the car I lent my mate，借出用 lend

zh: 我们订的那家酒店，评论都说早餐很差。
en: The reviews of the hotel we've booked say the breakfast is terrible.
alt: The hotel we've booked has reviews saying the breakfast is awful.
point: 主语是 the reviews of the hotel we've booked，别让 hotel 当主语

zh: 我在机场碰到了一个十年没见的大学同学。
en: At the airport I ran into a uni friend I hadn't seen for ten years.
alt: I bumped into an old uni mate at the airport who I hadn't seen in ten years.
point: “十年没见的同学”：a friend I hadn't seen for ten years

zh: 你最好买一份行李丢了也能赔的旅游保险。
en: You should get travel insurance that covers lost luggage.
alt: It's worth getting travel insurance that'll pay out if your bags go missing.
point: “…也能赔的保险”：insurance that covers…，cover 表示保障

zh: 我们走的那条步道，有一段要过吊桥。
en: The track we did has a section where you have to cross a swing bridge.
alt: There's a part of the track we walked where you cross a swing bridge.
point: 两个从句：the track we did / a section where…

zh: 游泳一定要去有救生员值班的海滩。
en: Make sure you swim at a beach that has lifeguards on duty.
alt: Always swim at a beach where there are lifeguards.
point: “有救生员的海滩”：a beach that has… 或 where there are…

zh: 开车来接我们的那个朋友，在步道终点等了我们一个小时。
en: The friend who was picking us up waited an hour for us at the end of the track.
alt: Our mate who was collecting us had to wait an hour at the end of the track.
point: “来接我们的朋友”：the friend who was picking us up

zh: 我们队那个老是迟到的人，今天又没来。
en: The guy on our team who's always late didn't turn up again today.
alt: The player on our team who's never on time was a no-show again today.
point: 从句隔开：the guy on our team who's always late

zh: 我报了一个专门给初学者上的网球课。
en: I've signed up for tennis lessons that are aimed at beginners.
alt: I've signed up for a beginners' tennis course.
point: “专门给…的”：that are aimed at…

zh: 我们支持的那支球队已经连输五场了。
en: The team we support has lost five games in a row.
alt: The team I follow has lost five on the trot.
point: “我们支持的球队”：the team we support；连输说 in a row

zh: 你借我的那本书我看完了，结局完全没想到。
en: I finished the book you lent me, and the ending was something I never saw coming.
alt: I've finished the book you lent me, and I didn't see the ending coming at all.
point: the book you lent me；“没想到的”：something I never saw coming

zh: 我们去的那个音乐节上，有个我从高中就开始听的乐队。
en: At the festival we went to, there was a band I've been listening to since high school.
alt: One of the bands at the festival we went to is one I've loved since high school.
point: listen to 的 to 不能丢：a band I've been listening to

zh: 我在找一个周末一起出去拍照的摄影小组。
en: I'm looking for a photography group that meets up on weekends.
alt: I'd like to find a photography club that goes out shooting at the weekend.
point: “周末一起…的小组”：a group that meets up…

zh: 我们约一个大家都方便过去的地方见面吧。
en: Let's meet somewhere that's easy for everyone to get to.
alt: Let's pick a place that's handy for everyone.
point: somewhere that's easy… to get to，句末的 to 别丢

zh: 我认识一个人，他妹妹在你们公司上班。
en: I know someone whose sister works at your company.
alt: I know a guy whose sister works for your company.
point: 中文拆成两句，英文用 whose 合成一句

zh: 来派对的人大部分我都不认识。
en: I didn't know most of the people who came to the party.
alt: Most of the people at the party were strangers to me.
point: 话题“来派对的人”放回宾语：most of the people who came

zh: 我们收到的请柬上写着他们不收礼物。
en: The invitation we got says they don't want any presents.
alt: The invite we received says no gifts, please.
point: “收到的请柬”：the invitation we got，后面直接接 says

zh: 圣诞节我们要去岳父母家，他们住在三个小时车程外。
en: We're spending Christmas with my in-laws, who live three hours' drive away.
alt: We're going to my in-laws' for Christmas, which is a three-hour drive.
point: 补充信息用 , who…；岳父母统称 in-laws

zh: 在葬礼上致辞的那位女士是她最好的朋友。
en: The woman who spoke at the funeral was her best friend.
alt: The lady who gave the eulogy was her closest friend.
point: “致辞的女士”：the woman who spoke at…

zh: 我们找到了一家离我上班的地方很近的幼儿园。
en: We've found a daycare that's close to where I work.
alt: We've found a daycare near my work.
point: “我上班的地方”说 where I work，不必说 the place I work

zh: 我儿子最好的朋友，就是住我们对面的那个男孩，下个月要搬走了。
en: My son's best friend, the boy who lives across the road, is moving away next month.
alt: The boy across the road, who's my son's best friend, is moving next month.
point: 插入同位语 the boy who lives across the road

zh: 我爸妈来的时候住的那个房间有点小。
en: The room my parents stay in when they visit is a bit small.
alt: The room my parents use when they come over is a bit cramped.
point: stay in 的 in 留在从句：the room my parents stay in

zh: 我们家狗最怕的就是打雷。
en: The one thing our dog's really scared of is thunder.
alt: What our dog's most afraid of is thunder.
point: scared of 的 of 留在从句末：the thing he's scared of

zh: 兽医说我们给猫用的那个驱跳蚤药不太管用。
en: The vet says the flea treatment we've been using on the cat doesn't really work.
alt: According to the vet, the flea stuff we use on the cat isn't very effective.
point: 宾语从句里再套定语从句：says the treatment we've been using…

zh: 我们在找一个可以带狗去的度假屋。
en: We're after a bach where we can take the dog.
alt: We're looking for a dog-friendly bach.
point: “可以带狗去的”：a bach where we can take the dog

zh: 我最受不了的是说话不算话的人。
en: The thing I can't stand is people who don't keep their word.
alt: What I can't stand is people who go back on their word.
point: 两个从句：the thing I can't stand / people who don't…

zh: 她是我遇到麻烦时第一个想到的人。
en: She's the first person I think of when things go wrong.
alt: She's who I turn to first when I'm in trouble.
point: the first person I think of，think of 的 of 不能丢

zh: 我不知道怎么面对那个被我辜负的朋友。
en: I don't know how to face the friend I let down.
alt: I don't know how to look my friend in the eye after letting her down.
point: “被我辜负的朋友”：the friend I let down，不用被动

zh: 我们上个月招的那个实习生学东西特别快，我在考虑让她参与下一阶段的项目。
en: The intern we took on last month is picking things up really quickly, so I'm thinking of bringing her onto the next phase.
alt: The intern who started last month is learning fast, so I'm considering putting her on the next stage of the project.
point: “招的实习生”：the intern we took on；招人说 take on

zh: 如果你收到一封重置密码的邮件，但你最近并没有申请过，千万别点里面的链接。
en: If you get a password reset email you didn't ask for, don't click on any of the links in it.
alt: If a password reset email turns up that you didn't request, don't click any links in it.
point: “你没申请过的邮件”：an email you didn't ask for，for 放末尾

zh: 我想订周六晚上八个人的位子，其中两个人吃素，你们有适合他们的菜吗？
en: I'd like to book a table for eight on Saturday night, and two of us are vegetarian, so is there much on the menu they can eat?
alt: Could I book for eight on Saturday evening? Two of us are vegetarian, so do you have dishes that would suit them?
point: “适合他们的菜”：much on the menu they can eat，从句省略 that

zh: 我周日早上一起跑步的那个群现在有二十多个人了，欢迎你随时来。
en: The group I run with on Sunday mornings has grown to over twenty people, so you're welcome to come along any time.
alt: The Sunday morning running group I'm in has got over twenty people now, so feel free to join us whenever.
point: run with 的 with 留在从句：the group I run with

zh: 我上周在你们店买的吸尘器，用了两次吸力就变得很弱，我想问能不能换一台。
en: The vacuum cleaner I bought from you last week lost most of its suction after two uses, so I was wondering if I could swap it.
alt: The vacuum I got here last week has hardly any suction after using it twice, so could I exchange it?
point: “在你们店买的”：the vacuum I bought from you，对店员说 from you

zh: 我们南岛自驾住过的那些汽车旅馆里，我最喜欢一家老板会给你做早餐的小店。
en: Of all the motels we stayed at on our South Island road trip, my favourite was a little place where the owner cooked you breakfast.
alt: My favourite motel on our South Island road trip was a small one where the owner made breakfast for you.
point: Of all the motels we stayed at…；地点从句 a place where…

zh: 你给我开的那种药吃了总是犯困，有没有不影响开车的替代药？
en: The medication you prescribed makes me really drowsy, so is there an alternative that won't affect my driving?
alt: The tablets you gave me make me sleepy, so is there something else I could take that won't affect my driving?
point: “你开的药”和“不影响开车的药”都要后置：the medication you prescribed

zh: 我们在给厨房找一种既耐用、又不用经常打理的台面。
en: We're after a kitchen benchtop that's tough enough for everyday use but doesn't need a lot of maintenance.
alt: We're looking for a hard-wearing kitchen benchtop that's low-maintenance.
point: 一个 that 带两个谓语：that's tough… but doesn't need…

zh: 你上次说的那个徒步群，能把组织者的联系方式发给我吗？我想问问他们下次什么时候活动。
en: Could you send me the details of the person who runs that walking group you mentioned? I'd like to find out when they're next heading out.
alt: Can you pass on the contact details for whoever organises that walking group you told me about? I want to ask when their next walk is.
point: 两层从句：the person who runs that group you mentioned

zh: 我打电话是想问一下，上周从我账户扣走的那笔钱我不认识，到底是什么？
en: I'm calling about a payment that came out of my account last week that I don't recognise.
alt: I'm ringing about a payment I don't recognise that was taken from my account last week.
point: 一个名词叠两个从句：a payment that came out… that I don't recognise

zh: 我很想申请你们网站上发的那个高级开发职位，但想先确认一下工作时间能不能灵活。
en: I'm keen to apply for the senior developer role you've advertised on your website, but I wanted to check whether there's any flexibility on hours first.
alt: I'd love to apply for the senior developer position on your website, but first I wanted to ask if the hours are flexible.
point: “你们发布的职位”：the role you've advertised，不说 your posted role

zh: 我上一份工作最自豪的，是带着一个原本合作不太好的团队按时完成了项目。
en: What I'm proudest of from my last job is leading a team that hadn't worked well together to deliver a project on time.
alt: The thing I'm proudest of in my last role is getting a team that didn't gel to deliver a project on time.
point: What I'm proudest of 作主语，of 不能丢

zh: 我今天拿到了offer，但薪水比我们面试时谈的低一些，你觉得我该怎么回？
en: I've just been offered the job, but the salary's a bit lower than what we talked about in the interview, so how should I respond?
alt: I got the job offer today, but the pay is a little less than we discussed at the interview, so what should I say?
point: 比较对象是一件事：lower than what we talked about

zh: 我在考虑报一个周末上课的IT证书课程，这样就不用请假了。
en: I'm thinking of doing an IT certificate that runs on weekends, which means I wouldn't have to take time off work.
alt: I'm considering a weekend IT certificate course, so I wouldn't need to take leave.
point: , which means… 指代前面整件事，不能用 that

zh: 上次给我们上写作课的那位老师说，我们写的大部分句子都太长了。
en: The tutor who took our writing session last time said most of the sentences we write are far too long.
alt: Our writing tutor from last time said most of our sentences are way too long.
point: 两个从句：the tutor who took… / the sentences we write

zh: 没来上第一节课的同学可以去课程网页下载课件，阅读材料也都在那儿。
en: Anyone who missed the first lecture can download the slides from the course page, where all the readings are too.
alt: If you missed the first lecture, the slides and readings are all on the course page.
point: anyone who missed…；非限定 , where… 补充地点信息

zh: 我们想续租，但新合同里有一条我们之前没注意到的条款，说租客要负责清理排水沟。
en: We'd like to renew the lease, but there's a clause in the new agreement we hadn't noticed before saying tenants have to clean the gutters.
alt: We want to renew, but the new agreement has a clause we missed that says tenants are responsible for the gutters.
point: 名词后叠加修饰：a clause… we hadn't noticed + saying…

zh: 下周来看房的那对夫妻问能不能带狗，你知道房东对这个是什么态度吗？
en: The couple who are coming to view the place next week asked if they could bring their dog, so do you know how the landlord feels about that?
alt: The couple viewing the house next week want to know if they can have a dog. Any idea what the landlord thinks?
point: “来看房的夫妻”：the couple who are coming to view…

zh: 我们在找一个愿意平摊房租、作息跟我们差不多的室友。
en: We're looking for a flatmate who's happy to split the rent and keeps roughly the same hours as we do.
alt: We need a flatmate who'll go halves on the rent and has a similar routine to ours.
point: 一个 who 带两个动作：who's happy to… and keeps…

zh: 你好，我住在你们后面那栋房子，想跟你聊聊我们两家中间那棵树的事。
en: Hi, I live in the house behind yours, and I wanted to have a chat about the tree that's on the boundary between us.
alt: Hi, I'm from the house at the back of yours, and I was hoping to talk to you about the tree between our properties.
point: “两家中间的那棵树”：the tree that's on the boundary

zh: 我们这条街几个人在组织每月一次的聚餐，主要是想让新搬来的人认识一下大家。
en: A few of us on the street are organising a monthly potluck, mainly so the people who've just moved in can meet everyone.
alt: Some of us on the street are starting a monthly shared dinner so that newcomers can get to know everyone.
point: “新搬来的人”：the people who've just moved in

zh: 有人看到一只白猫吗？她是我们养了十年的那只，昨晚没回家。
en: Has anyone seen a white cat? She's the one we've had for ten years, and she didn't come home last night.
alt: Has anybody seen our white cat? We've had her ten years and she didn't come back last night.
point: the one we've had for ten years：用 have 表示“养”

zh: 我打电话是想问一下，账单上那笔叫“线路费”的费用是什么，以前从来没见过。
en: I'm ringing about a charge on our bill called a line fee, which we've never seen before.
alt: I'm calling to ask about the line fee on our bill, because it's not something we've had before.
point: called… 简化从句，再加 , which we've never seen

zh: 上周来装网的技术员把我们的路由器放在了一个信号很差的角落里。
en: The technician who installed our broadband last week put the router in a corner where the signal's really weak.
alt: The tech who set up our internet last week stuck the modem in a corner with terrible reception.
point: 两个从句：the technician who installed… / a corner where…

zh: 我想换一个对用电多的家庭更划算的套餐，因为我们冬天一直开着暖气。
en: I'd like to switch to a plan that suits households that use a lot of power, since we have the heaters on all winter.
alt: I want to move to a plan that's better value for big power users, because our heaters are on all winter.
point: 从句套从句：a plan that suits households that use…

zh: 你上次介绍的那个电工报价比别人低，活儿也干得很干净，我以后还会找他。
en: That electrician you put us onto came in cheaper than the others and did a really tidy job, so I'd definitely use him again.
alt: The sparky you recommended was cheaper than the rest and did a great job, so I'd use him again.
point: “你介绍的电工”：the electrician you put us onto

zh: 你们去年给我们装的窗户已经开始漏风了，请问还在保修期内吗？
en: The windows you installed for us last year have started letting in a draught, so are they still under warranty?
alt: The windows you put in last year are getting draughty now. Are they still covered by the warranty?
point: “你们给我们装的窗户”：the windows you installed for us

zh: 我想找一个能处理老房子发霉问题的人，最好是有正规资质的那种。
en: I'm trying to find someone who can deal with mould in an old house, ideally someone who's properly qualified.
alt: I need someone who knows how to treat mould in older houses, preferably someone who's certified.
point: “…的那种（人）”：再补一个 someone who's…

zh: 我在网上填的地址变更表好像没提交成功，因为我一直没收到确认邮件。
en: I don't think the change of address form I filled in online went through, because I never got a confirmation email.
alt: It looks like the address change form I submitted online didn't go through, as I haven't had a confirmation email.
point: 长主语：the form I filled in online，后接 went through

zh: 你好，我想约一个下班以后的时间，因为工作日白天我实在走不开。
en: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment at a time that's outside working hours, as I can't get away during the day.
alt: Hi, could I make an appointment for after work? I can't get away during the day on weekdays.
point: “…以后的时间”：a time that's outside…，修饰 time

zh: IRD寄给我的那封信说我还有一笔税没交，但我不知道是哪一笔。
en: The letter IRD sent me says I've got some unpaid tax, but I'm not sure what it's for.
alt: IRD sent me a letter saying I owe some tax, but I've no idea what it relates to.
point: “IRD寄来的信”：the letter IRD sent me，不说 IRD's sent letter

zh: 我要报告一起车祸，在高速出口附近，有一个人看起来伤得很重。
en: I'm calling to report a crash near the motorway off-ramp, and there's someone who looks badly hurt.
alt: I need to report an accident by the motorway exit, and one of the people looks seriously injured.
point: there's someone who looks…：“有个人看起来…”

zh: 昨晚的暴风雨把我们家靠近电线的那棵大树吹歪了，你们能派人来看看吗？
en: Last night's storm has left the big tree that's next to the power lines leaning badly, so could you send someone out to look at it?
alt: The big tree by the power lines is leaning badly after last night's storm. Could someone come and have a look?
point: the tree that's next to the power lines，修饰语不前置

zh: 我在公交车上捡到一个钱包，里面有一张驾照，上面写着失主的名字。
en: I found a wallet on the bus with a licence in it that has the owner's name on it.
alt: I picked up a wallet on the bus, and there's a driver licence inside with the owner's name.
point: 中文分成几句，英文用 with + that 从句合成一句

zh: 我的车在你们这儿做WOF没通过，说是轮胎磨损，可现在这几个轮胎上个月才换的。
en: My car failed its WOF here because of worn tyres, but the ones on it now were only put on last month.
alt: The car failed the WOF here for tyre wear, but the tyres it's got on were only fitted last month.
point: the ones on it now：用介词短语代替 that are on it

zh: 我每天上班走的那条路在修，所以最近我都改坐渡轮了。
en: The road I take to work is being dug up, so I've been catching the ferry instead lately.
alt: They're doing roadworks on my usual route to work, so I've been getting the ferry.
point: “我走的那条路”：the road I take，走路线用 take

zh: 在机场租车的话，最好选一个包含全险的套餐，这样就不用担心小剐蹭了。
en: If you're hiring a car at the airport, go for a package that includes full cover, so you don't have to worry about minor scrapes.
alt: When you rent a car at the airport, choose a deal with full insurance so small scratches aren't a worry.
point: “包含全险的套餐”：a package that includes full cover

zh: 我们打算这周末去走你说风景很好的那条海岸步道，你觉得天气靠得住吗？
en: We're planning to do that coastal walk you said had great views this weekend, so do you reckon the weather will hold?
alt: This weekend we're doing the coastal track you said was so scenic. Think the weather will stay fine?
point: 从句里插 you said：the walk (that) you said had great views

zh: 去没有手机信号的地方徒步，一定要告诉别人你走哪条路、预计几点回来。
en: If you're tramping somewhere there's no phone coverage, make sure you tell someone the route you're taking and when you expect to be back.
alt: When you go tramping where there's no reception, always let someone know your route and when you'll be back.
point: somewhere 后直接接从句；“你走哪条路”说 the route you're taking

zh: 我们在海边捡到一只受伤的海鸟，有人知道附近哪里可以收留它吗？
en: We found an injured seabird on the beach, so does anyone know a place nearby that could take it in?
alt: We've found a hurt seabird at the beach. Does anyone know somewhere local that looks after injured birds?
point: “可以收留它的地方”：a place nearby that could take it in

zh: 我们读书会这个月读的书，是一个在奥克兰长大的作家写的，我觉得你会喜欢。
en: The book our book club's reading this month is by a writer who grew up in Auckland, and I think you'd enjoy it.
alt: This month our book club is reading a novel by an author who grew up in Auckland. I reckon you'd like it.
point: 两个从句：the book our club's reading / a writer who grew up…

zh: 我想找一个会剪照片里这种发型的理发师，你有推荐的吗？
en: I'm looking for a barber who can do the cut in this photo, so is there anyone you'd recommend?
alt: Do you know a barber who could do a haircut like the one in this picture?
point: a barber who can…；anyone you'd recommend 省略 that

zh: 我们一直想去的那家爵士酒吧周四晚上有免费演出，你有兴趣吗？
en: That jazz bar we've been meaning to try has a free gig on Thursday night, if you're keen.
alt: The jazz bar we keep saying we'll go to has a free show on Thursday night. Are you interested?
point: “一直想去的”：that bar we've been meaning to try

zh: 我们要给公公办七十大寿，想找一家能坐三十个人、还能自带蛋糕的餐厅。
en: We're throwing my father-in-law's seventieth and need a restaurant that can seat thirty and will let us bring our own cake.
alt: We're organising a 70th for my father-in-law and need a venue that holds thirty people and allows us to bring a cake.
point: 一个 that 带两个谓语：that can seat… and will let us…

zh: 今年我们想请那些过年回不了国的朋友来家里吃年夜饭。
en: This year we want to invite friends who can't go home for Chinese New Year round for a reunion dinner.
alt: This year we'd like to have friends who can't get back home for Chinese New Year over for a reunion dinner.
point: “回不了国的朋友”：friends who can't go home

zh: 我收到一个以前同事的婚礼邀请，但我们好几年没联系了，不知道该不该去。
en: I've been invited to the wedding of an ex-colleague I haven't been in touch with for years, and I'm not sure whether to go.
alt: An old colleague I haven't talked to in years has invited me to her wedding, and I can't decide if I should go.
point: be in touch with 的 with 留在从句末

zh: 我女儿的老师打电话说，坐她旁边的那个孩子最近老是欺负她。
en: My daughter's teacher rang to say the kid who sits next to her has been picking on her lately.
alt: My daughter's teacher called to tell me the boy next to her in class keeps bullying her.
point: 宾语从句里的主语带从句：the kid who sits next to her has been…

zh: 我们在找一个三点以后能帮忙接孩子、再看两个小时的保姆。
en: We're looking for a nanny who can pick the kids up after three and look after them for a couple of hours.
alt: We need someone who can collect the kids after three and mind them for two hours.
point: who can 带两个动作：pick up… and look after…

zh: 我爸妈下个月来新西兰，我们想带他们去一些他们以前没去过的地方。
en: My parents are coming over next month, and we want to take them to some places they've never been to before.
alt: My parents are visiting next month, so we'd like to show them a few places they haven't seen.
point: “没去过的地方”：places they've never been to，to 别丢

zh: 我们出门旅行的时候，你能帮忙照看一下我们那只特别挑食的猫吗？
en: While we're away, would you be able to look after our cat, who's incredibly fussy about food?
alt: Could you mind our cat while we're away? Just a warning, she's really picky about food.
point: 宠物有名字有感情时可用 who：our cat, who's…

zh: 兽医觉得我们给狗吃的那种狗粮可能就是它皮肤过敏的原因。
en: The vet thinks the food we've been giving the dog might be what's causing his skin allergy.
alt: According to the vet, the dog food we use could be behind his skin allergy.
point: “…的原因”说 what's causing…，不必说 the reason of

zh: 新房子虽然可以养宠物，但合同上写着宠物造成的任何损坏都要我们赔。
en: The new place allows pets, but the lease says we have to pay for any damage they cause.
alt: Pets are allowed at the new place, but according to the lease we're liable for any damage they do.
point: “宠物造成的损坏”：any damage they cause

zh: 我一直不知道该怎么跟一个刚失去父亲的朋友说话，总怕说错话。
en: I never know what to say to a friend who's just lost their dad, and I'm always scared I'll say the wrong thing.
alt: I'm never sure what to say to a friend whose dad has just died, because I'm worried I'll put my foot in it.
point: “刚失去父亲的朋友”：a friend who's just lost their dad

zh: 其实让我生气的不是他迟到，而是他连条消息都没发。
en: What annoyed me wasn't that he was late, it was that he didn't even send a text.
alt: It wasn't him being late that bothered me, it was the fact that he didn't even text.
point: “让我生气的”用 What annoyed me 作主语

zh: 我要跟你道歉，那天我说的那些话太过分了，那不是我真正的意思。
en: I owe you an apology, because the things I said the other day were out of line, and they're not what I really meant.
alt: I'm sorry about what I said the other day. It was out of line and not what I meant at all.
point: the things I said；“我真正的意思”是 what I really meant

zh: 上周会议上提出的问题我已经整理成一份汇总，附在这封邮件里，供大家参考。
en: I've put together a summary of the issues that were raised at last week's meeting, which I've attached to this email for your reference.
alt: Please find attached a summary of the points raised at last week's meeting, for your reference.
point: 限定从句 that were raised + 非限定 , which I've attached

zh: 我想申请调到惠灵顿分公司，那边团队做的正好是我最感兴趣的领域。
en: I'd like to request a transfer to the Wellington office, where the team works in the area I'm most interested in.
alt: I'm writing to request a transfer to our Wellington office, as the team there focuses on the field I'm most interested in.
point: , where… 补充地点；interested in 的 in 留在句末

zh: 因为项目延期而不得不加班的同事，下个月会安排调休。
en: Staff who have had to work extra hours because of the project delays will be given time in lieu next month.
alt: Anyone who's had to work overtime due to the project delays will receive time off in lieu next month.
point: 正式通知里“…的同事”用 staff who…；调休说 time in lieu

zh: 我们发现贵公司提供的软件有一个可能泄露客户数据的漏洞，请尽快处理。
en: We've identified a vulnerability in the software your company supplies which could expose customer data, and would ask that it be addressed urgently.
alt: We've found a flaw in the software you provide that could put customer data at risk, and we'd ask you to fix it as a matter of urgency.
point: “贵公司提供的软件”和“可能泄露数据的漏洞”都要后置

zh: 所有需要远程访问公司系统的员工，请在本周五前设置好双重认证。
en: All staff who require remote access to company systems must set up two-factor authentication by this Friday.
alt: Anyone needing remote access to our systems is required to set up two-factor authentication by Friday.
point: 正式通知：All staff who require…，从句后才是 must

zh: 我们正在评估几家供应商，重点考虑能提供本地数据存储和全天候支持的公司。
en: We're currently evaluating several vendors, with a focus on those that can offer local data storage and round-the-clock support.
alt: We're assessing a number of vendors and giving priority to those able to provide local data hosting and 24/7 support.
point: those that can…：用 those 代替前面的 vendors

zh: 我在上一份工作中负责的项目，正是贵公司现在在做的这类数字化转型。
en: The projects I led in my previous role involved exactly the kind of digital transformation that your organisation is currently undertaking.
alt: In my last position I led projects on the same kind of digital transformation your organisation is working on now.
point: “我负责的项目”：the projects I led；“这类”用 the kind of… that

zh: 感谢您的邀请，不过经过慎重考虑，我决定接受另一个更符合我职业规划的职位。
en: Thank you for the offer, but after careful consideration I've decided to accept a position that's more closely aligned with my career goals.
alt: Thank you very much for the offer. After careful thought, I've decided to take up another role that better suits my career plans.
point: “更符合…的职位”：a position that's more closely aligned with…

zh: 请问这个职位所在的团队是什么情况，向谁汇报？
en: Could you tell me a bit more about the team this role sits within, and who it would report to?
alt: Could you tell me more about the team this position is part of and who it reports to?
point: sit within 的 within 留在句末：the team this role sits within

zh: 我写信是想申请作业延期，因为家里出了一些我无法控制的紧急情况。
en: I'm writing to request an extension on my assignment, due to a family emergency that was beyond my control.
alt: I'd like to ask for an extension on my assignment because of a family emergency I couldn't have prevented.
point: “无法控制的情况”：that was beyond my control

zh: 我想咨询一下，已经有相关工作经验的学生是否可以免修部分课程。
en: I'd like to ask whether students who already have relevant work experience can be exempted from any of the papers.
alt: Could you advise whether students with relevant work experience are eligible for exemptions from some papers?
point: whether 从句里的主语带 who 从句，谓语 can be 别漏

zh: 我对上周公布的考试成绩有疑问，特别是论述题部分，希望能看一下评分标准。
en: I'd like to query the exam results that were released last week, particularly the essay section, and would appreciate seeing the marking criteria.
alt: I have some questions about last week's exam results, especially the essay section, and would be grateful to see the marking rubric.
point: “上周公布的成绩”：the results that were released last week

zh: 我们三月份在贵公司订的橱柜到现在还没送齐，而约好的安装工下周就要来了。
en: The kitchen cabinets we ordered from you in March still haven't all been delivered, and the installers we've booked are due next week.
alt: Not all of the cabinets we ordered from you in March have arrived, yet the installers we've arranged are coming next week.
point: 两个主语都带从句：the cabinets we ordered，安装工也一样

zh: 我想咨询贵公司的旧家具上门回收服务，具体是怎么收费的。
en: I'm enquiring about the furniture collection service you offer, and would like to know how the charges are calculated.
alt: I'd like some information about your furniture pick-up service, including how you work out the cost.
point: “贵公司提供的服务”：the service you offer，不说 your offered service

zh: 附件是我们打算在后院搭的棚子的设计图，请问是否需要事先申请许可？
en: I've attached the plans for the garden shed we're intending to build, and would be grateful if you could confirm whether consent is required.
alt: Please find attached the plans for a shed we'd like to put up in the backyard. Could you let me know if we'll need consent?
point: “打算搭的棚子”：the shed we're intending to build

zh: 我写信是想跟进上个月检查时发现的几个问题，包括浴室发霉和窗户漏水。
en: I'm writing to follow up on the issues that were identified at last month's inspection, including the mould in the bathroom and the leaking window.
alt: I'm following up on the problems noted at last month's inspection, namely the bathroom mould and the leaky window.
point: “检查时发现的问题”：the issues that were identified at…

zh: 我们希望全额退还押金，因为退房检查时提到的那处污渍，我们入住时就已经有了。
en: We'd like the full bond returned, as the stain that was noted at the final inspection was already there when we moved in.
alt: We're requesting a full refund of our bond, since the stain mentioned in the final inspection was there before we moved in.
point: 长主语 the stain that was noted… 后面接 was already there

zh: 不知道房东是否愿意考虑这样的安排：我们自费装一台热泵，作为交换租金保持不变。
en: Would the landlord be open to an arrangement whereby we pay for a heat pump ourselves in exchange for the rent staying the same?
alt: Would the landlord consider an arrangement in which we cover the cost of a heat pump and the rent stays the same?
point: 正式用语 an arrangement whereby…（= by which）

zh: 我写信是关于我们两家之间那道篱笆的，它已经坏得很严重，想跟您商量分摊修理费用。
en: I'm writing about the boundary fence between our properties, which is badly damaged, and I'd like to discuss sharing the cost of repairing it.
alt: I'm getting in touch about our shared boundary fence, which is in poor condition, as I'd like to talk about splitting the repair costs.
point: 非限定从句 , which is badly damaged 补充说明篱笆

zh: 我们这条街的住户联名写信，反映那个经常有人超速的路口存在安全隐患。
en: Residents of our street are writing jointly to raise concerns about the intersection where drivers regularly speed.
alt: We, the residents of this street, are writing together about the safety of the intersection where cars often go too fast.
point: “经常有人超速的路口”：the intersection where drivers speed

zh: 我想提议在那块空置已久的公共绿地上建一个社区菜园。
en: I'd like to propose that a community garden be set up on the piece of reserve land that has been sitting unused for some time.
alt: I'd like to suggest turning the reserve that's been left unused for a long time into a community garden.
point: “空置已久的绿地”：the land that has been sitting unused

zh: 我想对上季度的账单提出异议，账单金额明显高于我们实际用的电量。
en: I wish to dispute last quarter's bill, which is significantly higher than the amount of power we actually used.
alt: I'm writing to dispute last quarter's bill, as it's far higher than the power we actually used.
point: 非限定 , which is… + the amount of power we actually used

zh: 上周停电期间损坏的那台冰箱，请问贵公司是否会承担维修费用？
en: Could you advise whether your company will cover the cost of repairing the fridge that was damaged during last week's outage?
alt: Will you be covering the repair costs for our fridge, which was damaged in last week's power cut?
point: “停电时损坏的冰箱”：the fridge that was damaged during…

zh: 我们已经多次联系客服，但每次接待我们的人给的答复都不一样。
en: We've contacted customer service several times, but each person we've spoken to has given us a different answer.
alt: We've been in touch with customer service on several occasions, and every staff member we've dealt with has told us something different.
point: each person we've spoken to 作主语，谓语用单数 has

zh: 我们对贵公司上个月做的屋顶维修不满意，下雨时原来漏水的地方还在漏。
en: We're not satisfied with the roof repairs you carried out last month, as the area that was leaking before is still letting water in.
alt: We're unhappy with last month's roof repairs, because the part that leaked previously is still leaking.
point: 两个从句：the repairs you carried out / the area that was leaking

zh: 随信附上我们收到的三份报价，我们倾向于选择能在月底前完工的那家。
